prompt: zero-shot question plus step-by-step and boxed final answer; identical across models
pair_eligibility: training only; teacher completed correct final answer, student score zero; no loop-threshold requirement
contrast: equal-weight mean student-space final-256-reasoning-token outputs, failed student minus successful teacher; same question pairs
heldout_policy: Do not load heldout generation outcomes into edit routine. Evaluate original, teacher, candidate only after frozen edit; if fewer than 3 pairs, stop without edit.
on_budget_exhaustion: Stop; preserve completed rows and report incomplete coverage. Never shorten token allowance.
demonstration_exclusion: No demonstrations used in this independent zero-shot experiment. Official worker demonstration identities unavailable; no claim of exclusion from unknown official few-shot draws.
